summary: S19 '📞 À appeler' tab: backend + frontend tested end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest pass in test_to_call.py (endpoint reachable, group-1 rappel dû w/ HHhMM label, group-2 nouveau w/ 'Nouvelle demande — attend depuis N min', group-3 relance w/ '2e appel', group-4 injoignable w/ 'Classer Injoignable ?' label, non-callable statuses excluded, pre-tracking leads excluded, is_test leads gated behind store=test). Frontend verified live on preview URL: (1) '📞 À appeler' is FIRST tab and OPEN BY DEFAULT after login, with count badge; (2) freshly-created is_test lead appears with exact label 'Nouvelle demande — attend depuis 0 min' when store filter is 'test' and disappears from list when filter is cleared; (3) Appeler button (tel: href + call-log dialog open in same click) tested — identity modal fires first when identity is unset, then call-log dialog opens automatically via pending-action pattern; (4) group-4 row (injected 3 pas_de_reponse over 3 days into DB) shows exact label '3 appels sans réponse — classer Injoignable ?' + call-count badge '3'; 2-step 'Classer Injoignable' confirm works: 1st click reveals Confirmer/Annuler, only 2nd click PATCHes → DB verified status='client_perdu', lost_reason_code='injoignable', row disappears without reload; (5) STAFF_IDENTITY_STORE_MAP: selecting 'Équipe Lattes' via identity modal auto-preselects store filter to 'lattes' and still allows manual switch (verified switching to 'beziers'); (6) mobile (390×844) 'Client Perdu' modal: greyed-out Injoignable chip shows visible hint '0/3 appels — il faut 3 appels sans réponse sur 2 jours différents' via data-testid=lost-reason-injoignable-hint-{id}; Prix chip remains clickable. No regression on Devis / Contact / Entreprise / Rachat tabs (each shows correct count badge, list still renders). All is_test leads cleaned up post-test.

ui_bugs.issue: The store <select> does NOT include a 'Magasin TEST' option — admins have no built-in way to view is_test leads in the '📞 À appeler' tab from the UI. The backend supports store=test filter (verified end-to-end) but the UI dropdown lists only real STORES. During this test I had to inject the option manually via devtools. Suggest adding an <option value="test">Magasin TEST</option> (perhaps admin-only or dev-only) so the workflow described in the spec ('with store filter set to Magasin TEST') is actually reachable via the UI. Impact: functional gap when validating fresh test leads via the new tab.

action_items: Add a 'Magasin TEST' option to the admin-store-filter <select> so QA/admins can actually filter to test-store leads from the UI (currently unreachable without devtools). Options 'lattes','montpellier-nord',... are hard-coded from STORES which excludes the test store — add it explicitly.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPage.jsx is 1767 lines — still exceeds the 700-line guideline (pre-existing tech debt already flagged in iteration_16). ToCallTab extraction was a good first step; DemandCard / CallPanel / IdentityModal / status-change modal should follow.

ToCallTab.jsx handleCallSubmit awaits onLogCall then calls onRefresh() — good pattern, but onLogCall itself does an optimistic push in AdminPage.logCall then reloads; the extra onRefresh() re-fetch is a safety net but may cause a brief double-render. Low priority.

server.py get_to_call_list uses lexicographic ISO-8601 string comparison for created_at < tracking_since (line 1120) — same pattern as _unreachable_rule_satisfied; works because both are UTC ISO strings but a comment would help future-proof.
ToCallTab GROUP_BORDER accent classes use inline Tailwind arbitrary values (border-[#2ECC71]) — consistent with rest of codebase, fine.

The `test` store id is not exposed to the admin store-filter <select>, forcing indirect access; consider centralizing store options and injecting the test store when the current user has admin-level access.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 12 checks pass; 1 UX gap noted separately)

seed_data_creation: Created several is_test devis leads via POST /api/admin/notifications/test-lead during Playwright + pytest runs; also DB-injected call_attempts on those is_test leads for group-1/3/4 simulation. All is_test/test-store leads were deleted at the end (verified via pymongo cleanup query — 0 remaining). No real-store leads modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite for the new /api/admin/to-call endpoint lives at /app/backend/tests/test_to_call.py (8 tests, ~5s). It does DB-level injection on is_test leads to simulate group-1/3/4 rules (impossible to hit realistically via UI without waiting real business hours). The pytest fixture reads token from JSON key 'token' (NOT 'access_token'). To-Call UI testing requires the store filter set to 'test' which is not a native option — inject via devtools evaluate() as shown in this iteration's Playwright scripts. The identity modal uses a native <select data-testid=identity-select> (not a list of buttons) with confirm at data-testid=identity-confirm-btn.
rca of the issue: The only real issue found is the missing 'Magasin TEST' option in admin-store-filter <select>. Root cause: AdminPage.jsx line 617-620 renders <option> only from the STORES array imported from data/stores.js, which by design excludes the test store. Fix: append a static <option value='test'>Magasin TEST</option> after the STORES.map() loop (or conditionally, gated on some admin flag). No backend or business-logic bug — pure UI reachability gap.
